maddeler.e:
نفتخر (form VIII)
# نَفْتَخِرُ (naftaḵiru) /naf.ta.xi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَخَرَ (iftaḵara)
# نَفْتَخِرَ (naftaḵira) /naf.ta.xi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَخَرَ (iftaḵara)
# نَفْتَخِرْ (naftaḵir) /naf.ta.xir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِفْتَخَرَ (iftaḵara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
